answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 37435 Country: India Title: My name is Syed Zeeshanul Haq my friends and my relatives call me Zeeshan Question: My name is Syed Zeeshanul Haq my friends and my relatives call me Zeeshan. What is its meaning and is it better to call this name or any kind of bigness (takabbur) which is against Shariah laws. Please clarify. Answer ID: 37435 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 393/33/B=1433) Zishanul Haque is not a correct name. Only Zishan is correct. It means magnificent. It is also not a good name; it bears the reflection of praise and pride. Instead, if you keep any other name like Burhan, Arman, Farman, etc then it is better. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
